note: Deny-by-default (M3 stretch, D-037). A caller may perform an action ONLY if one of their directory groups (or their service identity) holds an explicit grant for it. Grants are the ACTION gate; the boundary's entitled() rule is the RECORD gate (which claims a group may see). Both must pass, in code, before any data moves. Synthetic sandbox; AutoSure is the single tenant.

actions.search_policy_clauses: search the AutoSure policy wording (Policy & Coverage KB)
actions.get_latest_draft: read the newest draft for a claim
actions.list_pending_recommendations: the adjuster queue: undecided drafts the caller may see
actions.create_escalation_ticket: open an SIU / escalation ticket (Escalation Ticketing, idempotent)
actions.get_escalation: read a claim's escalation ticket status
actions.ticket_webhook: deliver a signed ticket-status event from the ticketing system
